payload.claim: Eureka Forbes 355 has CADR 355 m3/h with True HEPA H13 at Rs 9,999
payload.quote: This is an extremely strong budget choice, offering a CADR of 355 m³/h, which is more than enough for most large apartments.

payload.claim: Realme TechLife has 330 m3/h CADR, Rs 7,999
payload.quote: Its 330 m³/h CADR clears our 300 m³/h bar for a 350 sq ft room, and it pairs a pre-filter with a True HEPA H13 main filter made by Sharp, along with a Sharp air quality sensor that drives a sensible auto mode.

payload.claim: Realme TechLife has a True HEPA H13 main filter
payload.quote: Its 330 m³/h CADR clears our 300 m³/h bar for a 350 sq ft room, and it pairs a pre-filter with a True HEPA H13 main filter made by Sharp, along with a Sharp air quality sensor that drives a sensible auto mode.

payload.claim: Realme TechLife has a HEPA H12 filter (99.95%), not H13
payload.quote: Realme Air Purifier has a HEPA H12 Filter that removes 99.95% of particles and PM 2.5 pollution which increases health risk.

payload.claim: Honeywell Air Touch V5 CADR is 380 m3/h
payload.quote: Its CADR of 380 m³/h makes it suited for large rooms like a living room.

payload.claim: Honeywell Air Touch V5 CADR is just 250 m3/h, undersized for 350 sq ft
payload.quote: Its rated CADR is just 250 m³/h, which clears the minimum rule of thumb but falls short of what a 350 sq ft room needs during a Delhi smog episode.

payload.claim: Mi Air Purifier 4 is Rs 14,999 on Flipkart and Rs 17,999 on Amazon
payload.quote: This purifier is available for Rs 14,999 on Flipkart and Rs 17,999 on Amazon.

payload.claim: Mi Air Purifier 4 lists at Rs 17,999 on Amazon and Flipkart
payload.quote: Unfortunately it now lists at ₹17,999 on both Amazon and Flipkart, so it sits outside this budget unless you catch a sale.

payload.claim: CADR in m3/h should be at least two-thirds of room area in sq ft (8-ft ceiling)
payload.quote: As a rule of thumb, the CADR should be at least two-thirds of the room’s area in square feet, with an assumption that the room has an 8-foot ceiling.

payload.claim: For Delhi, aim to cycle room air 3-4 times an hour; 300 m3/h or more is the goal for 350 sq ft
payload.quote: In Delhi you want the purifier to cycle all the air in the room three to four times an hour, and a 350 sq ft room with an 8-foot ceiling holds about 80 cubic metres of air, so 300 m³/h or more is the realistic goal.

payload.claim: Replacement filters typically run Rs 1,500 to 5,000 a year
payload.quote: Replacements typically run ₹1,500 to ₹5,000 a year, and you should confirm local availability before committing to a brand.

payload.claim: Realme filter indicator trips at 2,800 hours
payload.quote: It has a total of 2800 hours before it indicates changing.

payload.claim: Realme TechLife is 64 dB, third fan speed pretty loud, lowest has no noise
payload.quote: The 3rd fan speed is pretty loud, 2nd is just ok and the lowest has no noise at all.

payload.claim: Qubo Q600 has 450 m3/h CADR, HEPA H13, Rs 14,490
payload.quote: The Qubo Q600 boast a high CADR of 450 m³/h and an HEPA H13 filter.

payload.claim: Philips AC1711 has 300 m3/h CADR, ~50 dB, Rs 11,499
payload.quote: The Philips AC1711 has a high CADR (300 m³/h) but can be noisy at 50 decibels.

payload.claim: Levoit Core 300 is quiet (~24 dB) but CADR on the low side, Rs 10,999
payload.quote: While its CADR is on the lower side compared to some of its peers on this list, it has a big coverage area.

payload.claim: Qubo Q200 is 150 m3/h, up to 200 sq ft (too small)
payload.quote: Qubo Q200 Up to 200 Sq. Ft. True HEPA H13 Removes 99.99% Dust, Allergens, Smoke, Virus & PM2.5 150 m/h CADR 5-Stage FilterApp & Voice Control 9000 Hrs Filter Life Portable Room Air Purifier

payload.claim: Look for True HEPA H13 or H14; avoid HEPA-type labels
payload.quote: Don’t fall for vague labels like “HEPA-type” or “HEPA-like.”

payload.claim: Eureka Forbes 355 rated 63 dB, plasma stage listed
payload.quote: The trade-off is noise: it is rated at 63 dB, a lot for a bedroom, where under 30 dB is the comfort zone.

payload.claim: Large units have expensive filter sets (~Rs 8,400-8,490); Qubo Q1000 has 15,000h filter life
payload.quote: The 7-stage system is complex, and the full set of replacement filters is very expensive (over ₹8,000).

payload.claim: Filter replacement cost for Eureka Forbes 355 or Realme is stated in sources
payload.quote: Be wary of machines whose full filter sets cost ₹8,000 or more; those are usually larger living-room units anyway.
